leader: claude
worker: bwk
evaluator:
  handle: rsc
type: design
inputs:
  ticket: ethos-5y4r
write_set:
  - docs/design-opencode-plugin.md
  - DESIGN.md
success_criteria:
  - 'Authority: docs/spec-opencode-lifecycle.tex (accepted by jra after m-2026-10-22-048). Bring docs/design-opencode-plugin.md and DES-078 into exact agreement with every amendment in its ledger and every design section its consequences list names, citing the spec for each. This includes: origin discriminator (dkFork vs dkTierB; a new BoundVia value written by claim-forked) so deleteFiles, purge, reconcile, release and close-time clearing touch only open dkFork skeletons owned by the session; Tier B binding cleared and its skeleton left open; the durable claim-forked-pending record with its stage field, persisting for the life of the fork claim and removed only when its skeleton is closed; mission release (cmd/ethos/mission.go:2135-2179) and close-time claim clearing close the fork skeleton they unname; fixSupersede only on Fresh/Reuse (Reuse clause kept as defensive, documented as unexercised); SessionStart for every source routes through Ensure without touch; every skeleton close is compare-and-set on verdict open under the delegation lock, and the Store.Close sweep (locked and unlocked) takes each skeleton''s delegation lock; the reuse path takes the step-5 locks and re-reads the mission before writing.'
  - 'B2: the claim-forked-pending record stores the mission store root (resolve.StoreRepoRoot() at write time); deleteFiles step 1, release, and every reconcile close use that root; "mission directory gone" is concluded only from a recorded, resolvable root; an unknown or unresolvable root is a step-1 failure (roster kept as retry token), never "gone". Required test: delete run from a different working directory still closes the skeleton.'
  - 'Code-reviewer findings: DESIGN.md decision point 3 -- add --touch to the plugin ensure command (~12360), state Claude Code SessionStart uses Store.Ensure in-process without touch with the parentGone retry (~12374), replace the old write order with record, skeleton, post-check, binding, claim and the conditional reuse rule (~12370). Design rule 4: an existing roster that fails to load is not refreshed by ensure --touch; ensure writes nothing and exits non-zero (spec LcEnsureRefresh guard); add the test.'
  - 'Invariant-reviewer findings not covered by the spec: F4 exit-status table -- add rows for ReadActiveMissionBinding I/O error (child and witness), non-not-found ParentOf error, ReadDelegationBinding error in reconcile, record-removal failure, and post-check abort whose cleanup close also fails (assign one status); make witness iteration match the table (a mission-closed witness is "witness refused", so the next ancestor is tried); add a caller-action column for Claude Code SessionStart; fix the order of errors.As mapping relative to main.go:85-100 prefix test. F5 -- derive the guide deny list from the harness list (every harness name and literal, including OpenCode terms such as opencode.json and .opencode/plugins), add an @-import pattern, and name the persona-injection sentence (guide lines 19-20) for neutralization. F7 -- (a) assign the last-seen read-error branch consistently (not stale, warn); (b) state Store.Purge has no production caller and PurgeTombstoned requires --force (store.go:469-503), so C8 applies under --force; (c) delete the claim that ethos serve ages rosters out. F8 -- allowlist only the literal .punt-labs/ethos/CLAUDE.md; scan all of cmd/ethos and internal/doctor including uninstall.go:37-49, doctor remedy strings, and validate-content remedy text. F12 -- correct "a child whose roster is gone cannot have a record". Add crash-leftover temp names (last-seen.*.tmp, claim-forked-pending.*.tmp; active.go:290) to the deleteFiles removal list. State in the design doc which invariants are exhaustive and which are bounded, per the spec''s results table.'
  - 'rsc wording: a refusal never resumes the record (reuse applies only on the write-phase path); point the §2.1.1 purge paragraph''s opening to the round-8/9 bullets.'
  - 'Grep both files for every superseded claim (isStale row 2, deleteFiles order, "cycle cannot be written", same-delegation operator claim, "four non-success", record removed at finish, CreateInCheckout on resume/compact, atomic writes) and remove or mark each as superseded. Add a round-9 note to the design header and DES-078 naming m-2026-10-22-048.'
  - 'Commit incrementally -- one commit per logical step (file group, single concern, or single PR-equivalent slice). Each commit must pass `make check`. Do not accumulate more than 30 minutes of uncommitted changes.'
  - 'Commit by explicit path only: `git commit -m <msg> -- docs/design-opencode-plugin.md DESIGN.md`. Never stage, unstage, restore, or commit any other file.'
budget:
  rounds: 2
  reflection_after_each: true
context: 'Final design-text mission for DES-078, ethos-5y4r, PR #536, branch design/opencode-plugin-adapter, already checked out in <repo> -- do not create or switch branches. Commit on this branch; do NOT push, do not touch the PR or threads, do not merge. The spec is the authority; every criterion is a leader decision; if source or the spec shows one impossible, stop and report.'
